title: Spicy French Vegetarian Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir fry made with French-inspired flavors and vegetarian ingredients, perfect for a quick meal. This dish is a great way to enjoy the flavors of France with a twist.

ingredients.name: Mixed stir-fry vegetables (broccoli, carrots, bell peppers)

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the cubed French bread and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the mixed stir-fry vegetables and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Pour in the spicy sauce and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the vegetables are coated.
Stir in the creme fraiche and cook for an additional minute.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
